"''Understood, Agent Tierny.|Tierny and the security personnel|audio=FOSecurityPersonnel-TheEscape.flac|}} An '''individual''' worked as part of security aboard the [[First Order]] [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''.''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|19}} after [[Resistance]] operatives [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Jarek Yeager]] escaped from one of the [[Star Destroyer]]'s [[hangar]]s, the individual was contacted by [[First Order Security Bureau]]{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} [[Agent]] [[Tierny]], who informed them of the loose Resistance members on the [[Starship|ship]]. The agent then gave the individual a [[Code Red]]—to lock down all positions—to which the individual responded their understanding of the request. ==Behind the scenes== The security personnel appeared, albeit only through voice, in part two of the two-part episode "[[The Escape (episode)|The Escape]]," the finale of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 26]], [[2020]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Their voice actor was uncredited in the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}} {{1st}} {{Voice}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of unidentified First Order security personnel}} {{Reflist}} [[Category:First Order individuals]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Security personnel]]
